prompt_template.rationale: The ONLY v2.1 condition that beat random chance on held-out (20.9%, p<10^-6). Using it unchanged is the fair apples-to-apples test of generalization to fresh examples. No prompt variant is tested in Stage 7K.
prompt_template.user_template:
You classify a single vulnerable code snippet by its most-specific CWE Top-25 identifier.

Examples:

Snippet: user_input is concatenated into an SQL string: cur.execute('SELECT * FROM x WHERE y=' + user_input)
Answer: CWE-89

Snippet: an HTTP handler echoes request.args['q'] directly into an HTML response without escaping.
Answer: CWE-79

Snippet: the server reads filename = request.args['f']; open(os.path.join('/data', filename)) without checking for '..'.
Answer: CWE-22

Now classify this snippet. Reply with ONLY 'CWE-NNN' and nothing else.

Snippet (lang={lang}):
{desc}
Code: {code}

Answer:
prompt_template.placeholder_description: Three ChatML user turns of {lang, desc, code} fused into one turn as a frozen few-shot preamble. Examples cover ONLY the v2 dev CWEs (89, 79, 22) so the preamble does not leak truth labels for the Stage 7K categories.

sampled.note: exllamav3 1.6.7 default; Temperature(1.0) + Sample(). Matches v2 runner EXACTLY so Stage 7K is apples-to-apples with Stage 7J.

scoring.primary: scorer_v2b (no regex; 100% agreement with scorer_v2a on 1,100 v2.1 trials)

data_hygiene: No snippet model output will be read by the author before analysis is complete.
Prompt text is NOT allowed to change based on stage7k results.
Any post-hoc change to the prompt or scorer invalidates this evaluation.
